description: Document processing pipeline: preprocessing (deskew, enhance, denoise for images), conversion to Markdown/CSV/Images using pytesseract and python-docx, and background task orchestration. This implements the core document transformation pipeline that runs after upload.
steps: Add dependencies to pyproject.toml: Pillow, pytesseract, python-docx, pymupdf (fitz for PDF text/image extraction), pandas (for CSV table output). Note: pytesseract requires tesseract-ocr system package - add a note in README but handle gracefully if not available.

Create app/services/preprocessing.py (PreprocessingService): deskew_image (using Pillow rotate with OSD from pytesseract or simple heuristic), enhance_image (contrast enhancement with PIL.ImageEnhance), denoise_image (median filter with PIL.ImageFilter). Each takes PIL.Image and returns PIL.Image. Add a preprocess_pipeline method that chains all three.

Create app/services/converter.py (ConversionService): convert_pdf (extract text via pymupdf, extract images, extract tables as CSV), convert_docx (extract text/images via python-docx), convert_image (OCR via pytesseract with preprocessing). Each returns a ConversionResult dataclass with: markdown_content (str), tables (list of CSV strings), images (list of PIL.Image or paths), metadata (dict).

Create app/services/pipeline.py (PipelineService): orchestrates the full processing flow. Takes a document ID, determines file type, runs preprocessing if image/scanned, runs conversion, saves markdown to storage/{group_id}/markdown/{doc_id}.md, saves extracted images to storage/{group_id}/images/{doc_id}/, saves tables as CSV files, updates document status in DB.

Integrate pipeline into document upload: in app/api/documents.py, after successful upload, launch pipeline as a FastAPI BackgroundTask. Update document status to 'processing' immediately, then 'processed' or 'failed' after pipeline completes.
Add GET /api/documents/{id}/markdown endpoint that returns the converted markdown content.
Add GET /api/documents/{id}/status endpoint for checking processing status.

Create tests/test_pipeline.py: test preprocessing functions with a synthetic image (create a PIL Image with text), test PDF conversion with the fixture PDF, test DOCX conversion with a programmatically-created DOCX fixture, test pipeline orchestration with mocked services, test status transitions.

Handle tesseract not being installed gracefully: if pytesseract raises an error, fall back to pymupdf text extraction for PDFs, and set a warning in the document metadata. Log the error but don't crash.
acceptance_criteria: Running 'uv run pytest tests/test_pipeline.py -v' passes all tests
Uploading a PDF triggers background processing and eventually sets status to 'processed'
After processing, a markdown file exists at the expected storage path
GET /api/documents/{id}/markdown returns markdown content for a processed document
If tesseract is not installed, PDF processing still works via pymupdf fallback
Image preprocessing functions (deskew, enhance, denoise) accept and return PIL Images without error
verification: uv run ruff check app/ tests/
findings: Tests required file-based SQLite instead of in-memory for background task testing since background tasks create their own DB connections. The conftest was updated to use file-based temp DBs. Document upload now sets initial status to 'processing' instead of 'uploaded'. Used module-level pipeline_db_url variable for test DB URL override.
